<entry id="H01739">
<head-word>חָרַף</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to scrape, sharpen, grind</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. חָרוּף, f. חֲרוּפָה, pl. חֲרוּפוֹת. Pesik. R. s. 21 פנים ח' sharp (severe) countenance (Var. הדופות).—Trnsf. 
<italic>to deflour</italic>, v. infra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. חלף) 
<italic>to change, transform; to change possession.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<italic> Part. pass</italic>. f. חֲרוּפָה 
<italic>designated for change of condition</italic>, v. חֲרוּפָה.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נֶחֱרַף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (of grist) (of grist) 
<italic>to be ground;</italic> trnsf. 
<italic>to be defloured, have intercourse</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Kidd. I, 59
<sup>a</sup> top (expl. Lev. XIX, 20) נֶחֱרֶפֶת … בכתושה לפני איש 
<italic>‘ne</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>ĕ</italic>
<italic>refeth</italic> by a man’ means crushed before a man (with ref. to Prov. XXVII, 22, v. הֲרִיפוֹת).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to change condition</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kerith. 11
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to נחרפת explained by בְּעוּלָה) מאי משמע … דשנויי הוא (Rashi: דשינויא) what proof is there that 
<italic>ne</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>ĕ</italic>
<italic>refeth</italic> has the meaning of change from natural condition? Answ. ref. to הָרִיפוֹת (II Sam. XVII, 19) and to Prov. l. c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חֵרֵף, חֵירֵף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. גָּרַף, גָּדַף) [
<italic>to scrape off</italic>,] 
<italic>to revile, blaspheme, shame</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 7, end מְחָרֶפֶת ומגדפת she (Rome) blasphemes and reviles. Num. R. s. 10 מְחָרְפָם, v. גָּדַף. Snh. 94
<sup>a</sup>, sq. שחי' ע"י וכ' who blasphemed (the Lord) through a messenger; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְחָרֵף, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְחָרֵף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be reviled</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXIV, end שמִתְחָרֵף ומתנאץ which is reviled and blasphemed. Ib. to Ps. XVIII, 1 עד שנִתְחָרַפְתִּי until I was reviled; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to become white, pale</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. B’resh. 12 (play on קיץ וחרף) שתהיו מתקייצין ופניכם מִתְחָרְפִין (some ed. מתחפרין) that you will feel nauseous and your faces become pale.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<definition>;

<notes> Targ. I Sam. XIII, 20, sq. Targ. Job XVI, 9 (not חָרִיף; h. text ילטש).—Part. pass. מְחַרַף. Targ. Jer. IX, 7 ed. Lag. (oth. ed. מְחָרֵיף, corr. acc.). Targ. Is. V, 28.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to blaspheme, revile</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Lev. XXIV, 11.; a. fr.—[Ib. 15, sq. יֶחֱרַף 
<italic>Pe.!</italic>]</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַחֲרִיף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be quick, be early</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 70
<sup>b</sup> אַחֲרִיפוּ ועולו וכ' go in early (before sunset), and leave early, that people may take notice of you. Sabb. 115
<sup>a</sup> דהוו קא מַחְרְפֵי that they did it earlier (than they were told to).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="H01749">
<head-word>חָרַץ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to dig a cavity, to cut a trench</italic> of even width all through.</definition>
<notes> Y. Kil. VII, 31
<sup>b</sup> bot. חפר ח' נעץ וכ' if (on the Sabbath) one dug (a pit), made a trench, and cut a wedge-like ditch (narrow below), he is guilty of one act; Y. Sabb. VII, 9
<sup>d</sup> bot.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to decree, designate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. B’ḥuck. 1 (ref. to Job XIV, 5) ח' ימיו וכ' He designated the duration of life of every creature.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. חָרוּץ, f. חֲרוּצָה; pl. חֲרוּצִים, חֲרוּצוֹת a) 
<italic>grooved</italic>. Sabb. 98
<sup>b</sup> ח' היו הקרשים וב' the boards of the Tabernacle were grooved, and the sockets hollowed out correspondingly.—b) 
<italic>decreed, decided; determined</italic>. Gen. R. s. 67 (ref. to Prov. XII, 27) the blessings שמעיקר העולם חרוצות לו which were designated to him from primeval days. Ib. חרוצה ביד וכ' it is a decided fact known to the righteous that they will in this world receive none &c. Deut. R. s. 1 שידיך חדות וח' that thy hands are quick and determined.—c) 
<italic>flat-nosed</italic>, v. חָרוּץ.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נֶחֲרַץ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be cut into, dug, ploughed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Nidd. I, 49
<sup>a</sup> bot. a soil is called virgin כל שלא נ' בה מימיה when it has never been cut into; v. חֶרֶץ.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>a</sup> מיחרץ ח' (a dry scab is) cut into (deeper than the surface).</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to think, intend, plan</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 6
<sup>a</sup>; Kidd. 40
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Mal. III, 16) אפי' ח' אדם וכ' even if one only had the intention of doing etc.; Sabb. 63

<italic>Pi.</italic>).—Tanḥ. P’kudé 11 וכשהן חוֹשְׁבִין להעמידו וכ' and when they thought they had put it up, it fell apart again. Sot. 35
<sup>a</sup> אני חֲשַׁבְתִּיהָ … והם חָשְׁבוּ וכ' I planned it for their good, but they considered it an evil; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to consider, regard; to count</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 14
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Is. II, 22) במה חֲשַׁבְתּוֹ לזה ולא לאלוה with what right didst thou pay thy regard to him and not to God?—Sot. l. c., v. supra. Pesik. R. s. 21, v. סוֹפִיסְטָא; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to design, trace</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 72
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to חשב a. רקם, Ex. XXVI, 31
<sup>a</sup> 36) רוקמין במקום שחוֹשְׁבִין they embroidered over what they had traced.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. חָשׁוּב fem. חֲשׁוּבָה a) 
<italic>counted, regarded</italic>; ח' כ־ 
<italic>equal to</italic>. Lam. R. to I, 5 לא … מדינה ח' כלום the country towns were of no account. Ned. 64
<sup>b</sup> ח' כמת is like dead; ib. חֲשׁוּבִין כמת; Gen. R. s. 71 חֲשׁוּבִים כמתים; a. fr.—b) 
<italic>valuable; important; respectable, of high standing</italic>. Bets. 3
<sup>b</sup> ביצה ח' an egg is a valuable object. Ber. 19
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. אדם ח' שאני with a man of high standing it is different. Pes. 108
<sup>a</sup> אשה ח' a woman of rank. Tanḥ. Shmini 9 איש ח' שמחשבים וכ' a man of standing whom they respected in his place; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<sense>

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to consider, regard; to respect</italic>, v. supra.</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to account, calculate, figure</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath 78
<sup>b</sup> המְחַשְּׁבִים the thoughtful. Sabb. 150
<sup>a</sup>. חשבונות … לחַשְּׁבָן וכ' accounts of a religious nature may be figured out on the Sabbath. Ab. II, 1 הוי מְחַשְּׁב וכ' count what you sacrifice in doing good, against what you gain thereby. Snh. 65
<sup>b</sup> המח' עתים וכ' he who calculates seasons and hours (which are auspicious and which are not). Ib. 97
<sup>b</sup> מְחַשְּׁבֵי קיצין those who make calculations (from Biblical verses) as to when the Messiah will come; a. fr.—[Sabb. 150
<sup>b</sup> top מותר לחוֹשְׁבָן (Kal), Ms. M. לחַשְּׁ'.]—V. חֶשְׁבּוֹן.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (sub. מחשבה זרה) 
<italic>to have in mind an undue intention in the performance of a sacrificial ceremony</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 48
<sup>a</sup> חי' בחפינת וכ' if he had an undue intention when grasping the frankincense (e.g. to offer it tomorrow). Ib.
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>

III, 3 עד שיִתְחַשֵּׁב וכ' until it is calculated that all the original water has run off. Pesik. R. s. 44 the former sins אינן מִתְחַשְּׁבוֹת לו וכ' are not counted or remembered to him.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be considered, believed to be</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Masé 5, v. כַּזְבָּן.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to occupy a high position.</italic></definition>
<notes> Shebi. VIII, 11 אם מתחשב הוא (Ms. M. כמ', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if he (is like one who) holds a high position.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to conspire</italic> (with the Romans).</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Ab. Zar. II, 7 ואם מתחשב וכ' but when he (the Israelite besieging a city) does it as an ally (in the Roman interest), he is forbidden (to conduct the siege); Ab. Zar. 18
<sup>b</sup> ובלבד שלא יִתְחַשֵּׁב עמהם provided he does not conspire with them; ואם נתח' וכ' (Ms. M. יתח'); Y. ib. I, 40
<sup>a</sup> מתחשד (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cut, dissect; to sever</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 33
<sup>a</sup> חוֹתֵךְ כזית וכ' cuts out flesh of the size of an olive. Ib. 32
<sup>a</sup> ח' דלעת וכ' if in slaughtering he cut a pumpkin at the same time. Ib. 48
<sup>b</sup> a. e. חוֹתְכָהּ מכאן וכ' he amputates on one place and the animal survives &c. Bets. 32
<sup>b</sup> חוֹתְכָהּ באיר he may sever the wick over the light. Y. Meg. IV, 75
<sup>a</sup> חותך the reader cuts one verse into two (reading Gen. I, 5, a. I, 8 as two verses severally); a. fr.—[Lev. R. s. 10 לחתוך את אביו וכ', v. חָתַר.]—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. חָתוּךְ 
<italic>cut into, having the incisions of limbs &c., outlined</italic>. Nidd. 24
<sup>b</sup> גוף שאינו ח' a shapeless body (not articulated); ראש שאינו ח' a shapeless head (without indications of the nose &c.) Ib. 24
<sup>a</sup> יד חֲתוּכָה a well-shaped hand (of an embryo); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. פָּסַק, גָּזַר)

<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition />
<notes> ששם חוֹתְכִין את ההלכה for there they decide the practice. Ib. וחוֹתֶכֶת דיניהם וכ' and decides the cases &c. Shebu. 30
<sup>b</sup> bot. אֶחְתְּכֶנּוּ I will decide the case (in accordance with the testimony).—Part. pass. as ab. Y. Snh. IV, beg. 22
<sup>a</sup> אילו … התורה חתוכה if the Law had been given in the form of clear decisions (leaving no room for differences of opinion, discretion &c.)</notes></sense></senses>

<sup>a</sup> נֶחְתְּכָה דלעת וכ' if by accident a pumpkin has been cut simultaneously with the animal (opp. to חָתַךְ, v. supra); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be decided, decreed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. 15

<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>

<sense>

<italic>to cut</italic>.</definition>

<sup>b</sup> מחתך לה וכ' he carves the foreleg and then boils it.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְחוּתָּךְ 
<italic>piecemeal, limbwise</italic>. Y. Nidd. III, 50

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to decide</italic>.</definition>

<entry id="H01899">
<head-word>חָתַם</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. b. h. חָתַל)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>, 
<italic>to tie up, close, lock</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. B’resh. 1 ח'את הים וכ' he locked the Ocean up, that it might not go forth &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to seal</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42
<sup>c</sup> bot. טבעת שׂחוֹתֵם בה the ring with which he seals. Ib. אסור לַחְתּוֹם בה you dare not use it for a seal; Tosef. ib. V (VI), 2; a. fr.—2) 
<italic>to sign, subscribe</italic> (as witness, judge &c.) Gitt. VI, 7 אחד … חוֹתְמִין one writes the document and two sign it as witnesses. Ib. 66
<sup>b</sup> ח' סופר if the scribe signed as one of the witnesses. Ib. 67
<sup>a</sup> ואתם חֲתוֹמוּ and sign you. Shebi. X, 4 הדיינים חותמין וכ' the judges sign under it; a. fr.—Part. pass. חָתוּם, f. חֲתוּמָה; pl. חֲתוּמִים, חֲתוּמִין; חֲתוּמוֹת. Yeb. 25
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. עדים הח' וכ' if witnesses are signed &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to close</italic> a benediction (v. 
<xref rid="H01888">חֲתִימָה</xref>).</definition>
<notes> Pes. X, 6 וחותם בגאולה and he closes with redemption (Blessed be the Lord who redeemed Israel). Ib. לא היה חותם he did not close with a benediction. Ber. I, 4 מקום שאמרו לַחְתּוֹם where the Rabbis ordained to close a benediction with Barukh &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab. Gitt. 60
<sup>a</sup> תורה ח' ניתנה the Law was given as one complete book, opp. מגילה מגילה in single sheets. [Cant. R. to I, 11, v. next w.]</notes></sense></senses>
<pgbrk id="pg514" />
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חִיתֵּם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to provide with signatures</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Gitt. I, beg. 43
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. מְחַתְּמוֹ בעדים וכ' he may have provided it with the signatures of unfit witnesses. Ib. חִתְּמוֹ וכ'.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְחוּתָּם. Y. Keth. II, 26
<sup>c</sup>; Y. Shebu. IV, 35
<sup>c</sup> מח' בארבע וכ' provided with four signatures.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נֶחְתַּם, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְחַתֵּם, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpa.</italic> נִתְחַתֵּם </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be signed, sealed.</italic></definition>
<notes> Gitt. I, 1 בפני נח' (Y. ed. נתח') in my presence has it been signed; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be finally sentenced</italic> (by attaching the seal or signature).</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. 16
<sup>b</sup> נכתבין ונֶחְתָּמִין וכ' their verdict is written and sealed at once; Y. ib. I, 57
<sup>a</sup> מִתְחַתְּמִין. Gen. R. s. 31, beg. נתח' גזר דינם their decree was sealed; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="H01904">
<head-word>חָתָן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) 
<italic>connection, son-in-law; bridegroom;</italic> (metaph., with ref. to the covenant of circumcision, v. 
<xref rid="B01282">בְּרִית</xref>) 
<italic>the infant fit for circumcision</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 98
<sup>b</sup> ח' הדר וכ' a son-in-law who lives in the house of his father-in-law. Pes. 113
<sup>a</sup> הוי זהיר … מחָתְנָהּ הראשון guard thy wife against her former affianced. Y. Ned. III, end, 38
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Ex. IV, 24 sq) משה קרוי ח' Moses is called the 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>athan</italic> … (and she said) חָ' דמים מתבקשין ממך (ed. מתבקש) husband, blood (circumcision) is asked of thee; תינוק קרוי ח' the infant is called the 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>athan</italic>, (and she said) חָ' בדמים אתה עומד לי child of the covenant, a high price I pay for thee; Bab. ib. 32
<sup>a</sup>; Ex. R. s. 5 חָתְנִי תהיה את וכ' thou shalt be my affianced by covenant, thou art given to me &c. Nidd. V, 3 an infant one day old … is לאביו … כח' שלם (as regards mourning ceremonies) like a perfect circumcised child to his parents &c.—Ber. II, 5 ח' פטור וכ' a bride-groom in the first night is exempt &c. Keth. 8
<sup>a</sup> (in wedding benedictions) משמח ח' עם הכלה who causest the bridegroom to rejoice with the bride; a. fr.—Trnsf. (cmp. בַּעֲלָא) 
<italic>the fructifying rain</italic>. Ber. 59
<sup>b</sup>; Taan. 6
<sup>b</sup> משיצא ח' לקראת כלה when the bridegroom goes forth to meet the bride, i.e. when the falling rain-drops meet the water on the ground and bubble; [oth. opin.; when the rivulets formed by the rain meet each other in gutters.].—
<plural-form>Pl. חֲתָנִים</plural-form>. Keth. l. c. Ib.
<sup>b</sup>, v. בְּרָכָה; a. fr.—</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H01910">
<head-word>חָתַר</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to dig, break in, make an opening</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 24
<sup>b</sup> חֲתוֹר לי שיני Ar. (ed. לַחְתּוֹר לו שינו) scrape my tooth (to clean it). Deut. R. s. 2 (ref. to וַיֵּעָתֶר, II Chr. XXXIII, 13) וַיֶּחְתַּר לו וכ' the Lord made an opening for his prayer; ח' את הרקיע He broke through the heavens; Y. Snh. X, 28
<sup>c</sup> bot.; Ruth R. to II, 14 ח' לו חתירה וכ' (v. Snh. 103
<sup>a</sup>).—Ex. R. s. 37 נטל את הצפורן לַחְתּוֹר וכ' (Ar. s. v. צפורן: לחפור) he took the digging tool to undermine his father’s house; Lev. R. s. 10 (לחתך, אחתוך, לחתוך את אביו) (corr. acc.). Gen. R. s. 63 (ref. to וַיֶּעְתַּר, Gen. XXV, 21, v. supra) like a prince שהיה חוֹתֵר על אביו ליטול וכ' who undertook a siege (for military practice) against his father for a
